description: PLEASE DO NOT APPLY TO THIS IF YOU HAVE NOT CONTRIBUTED TO NETTY OPEN SOURCE OR BUILT HIGH-PERFORMANCE NETTY APPLICATIONS Netty Proxy Statement of Work ======================== The safekids.ai HTTP proxy is based on NITM proxy which is an opensource codebase. It was forked predominantly to address core issues with lack of maintenance of the codebase. It is available in limited public view at [link] Safe Kids Proxy is built in JAVA and utilizes NETTY for all relevant protocols. The proxy can operate in both transparent mode or via HTTP proxy mode. Goal 1 (make sure everything works) and improve performance ===== While the proxy is fully functional, extensive tests need to be done to make sure NO functionality is broken on a machine where the proxy runs. This includes windows and mac operating systems and testing multiple browsers and applications on those machines including but not limited to App Stores, Office programs, chat apps like Discord, Slack etc. In addition, the goal is to make this extremely high performing where the user should not notice any degradation in latency and functionality. We need to create multiple test suites to automate this process and make sure nothing in the protocol core is broken. The codebase would need refactoring to make sure it performs exceptionally well. Goal 2 (intercept and replace content and support compression types) ============================================= The second step is to enable the proxy to modify the content of the website. This part has been implemented but needs to be refactored to make it cleaner and high performing. The class is Http2RawInterceptHandler.java under http2 but another similar functionality needs to be created for HTTP1 as well. The class intercepts based on the content type (for e.g. text/html). In this case, it decompressed the content, replaces it with user defined content, compressed it again and send it to the browser. Compression types including gzip, brotli and deflate. In the case of brotli, the brotli DLL which is part of the brotli for java package is considered by anti virus to be a compromised DLL (perhaps because it is not signed). Ideally, we should have a nice implementation that doesn’t cause anti virus issues.
